events.title: King Æthelred I of Northumbria is murdered
events.description: Æthelred I was killed at Corbridge by his own nobles. His death, typical of Northumbria's violent politics, came three years after Viking raiders had sacked the monastery at Lindisfarne.

events.title: The Peace of Ferrara ends a campaign of the Wars in Lombardy
events.description: With the mediation of the Pope, Venice, Milan, Florence and the Gonzaga signed a peace at Ferrara, ending the second campaign of the Wars in Lombardy. Venice kept Brescia and gained Bergamo, and Florence recovered strongholds it had lost.

events.title: Julius II lays the foundation stone of the new St Peter's
events.description: Pope Julius II laid the first stone of Bramante's new basilica in Rome. Building took 120 years and drew on Michelangelo, Maderno and Bernini.
events.html: Pope Julius II laid the first stone of Bramante's new basilica in Rome. Building took 120 years and drew on Michelangelo, Maderno and Bernini.

events.title: Boston revolts against the Dominion of New England
events.description: Militia and citizens in Boston, prompted by news of the Glorious Revolution, rose against Sir Edmund Andros, governor of the Dominion of New England, and arrested dominion officials. Leaders of the former Massachusetts Bay Colony then reclaimed the government.

events.title: Paul Revere rides to warn of British troops
events.description: Paul Revere and William Dawes rode from Boston to warn that British regulars were marching to seize colonial arms. The first shots of the Revolutionary War were fired at dawn the next day.

events.title: Earthquake and fire devastate San Francisco
events.description: A magnitude 7.9 earthquake struck before dawn, and fires burned for three days. Some 3,000 people died and more than half the city's population was left homeless.
events.html: A magnitude 7.9 earthquake struck before dawn, and fires burned for three days. Some 3,000 people died and more than half the city's population was left homeless.

events.title: Yankee Stadium opens with a Babe Ruth home run
events.description: Babe Ruth hit a three-run home run in the first game at the new Bronx ballpark, quickly nicknamed 'The House That Ruth Built'. It was home to the Yankees until 2008.

events.title: Albert Einstein dies in Princeton
events.description: Albert Einstein died aged 76. His theories of special and general relativity and his work on light quanta transformed physics in the twentieth century.
